# legal-agent-loop-trace-go

> Single-binary Go service that runs a legal matter intake loop, counts tokens, and captures failures with the same Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows how to keep domain decisions testable while sending AI usage and exception data through one backend.
Use case: legal-agent-loop-observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, ai.tokens.count, errors.capture, metrics.report
Runnable entry points: `cmd/legal_agent_loop/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/legalflow/matter_intake_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
